messages:
Ravi S: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating owners and pragmatic steps to stop mid-stream silence and reduce partials. Keeping it short.

Elena T: Short impact summary?

Ravi S: Observed ~2.1% of streams experienced a silence gap >3s, ~0.5% produced truncated partial responses. Spike aligned with background eviction window but traces show interleaving with the write/flush path.

Marta G: Root cause sketch: eviction sometimes runs in hot code path and steals CPU/IO, pausing the flush loop for 50-400ms. Clients often treat that as a broken stream and reconnect which can duplicate or truncate output.

infra-bot: Incident created INC-2026-820. Linked runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/stream-silence (tags: reconnect, partials)

Ravi S: Proposed minimal-risk runbook: 1) client: resume dedupe + gentler backoff; 2) infra: introduce an eviction gate so eviction and flush don't overlap; 3) observability: heartbeat probe and silence-gap metric.

Elena T: I can own observability. Plan: heartbeat probe that opens a 50s stream and asserts no silence >2.5s. Emit telemetry.metric.streaming.silence_gap_pct and a bucketed histogram of gap ms. Dashboard + alert. Target: 2026-04-04.

Marta G: I'll take the runtime change. Implementation: add a small mutex around flush and a non-blocking eviction gate (kv_eviction_gate) that serializes eviction with flush. Also emit eviction.gate_wait_ms. PR -> staged canary -> rollout plan. PR due: 2026-03-29.

Ravi S: Client SDK defaults suggestion (owned by PM/SDK): resumeDedupeWindowMs=2500, maxReconnects=3, baseBackoffMs=150, jitter=true. Make resume-dedupe opt-in for one release. Client doc due: 2026-03-27.

Elena T: Alerting rules: page SRE for streaming.silence_gap_pct > 0.6% sustained over 10m in production. Lower thresholds for staging. Dashboard will split by model, region, and deployment type.

Marta G: Canary plan: run targeted stress harness with 1.5k concurrent streams for 10m while toggling kv_eviction_gate to force evictions every 25s. Success if silence_gap_pct < 0.3% and reconnect rate returns to baseline. Canary window: maintenance slot 2026-04-01.

Ravi S: Rollback plan: flip kv_eviction_gate=false or revert PR if canary regresses. Client changes are opt-in for one release then default.

infra-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-04-05 13:00 UTC. Reminder set.

Elena T: I'll instrument a gap histogram: telemetry.streaming.silence_gap_ms_bucketed so we can tune dedupe windows per-model. Will post dev dashboard link when ready.

Marta G: Will add unit tests and a small integration test that simulates eviction while a flush is in-flight. Posting PR when available.

Ravi S: Ownership recap + due dates:
- Elena T — heartbeat probe, histogram, dashboard, alert — due 2026-04-04
- Marta G — kv_eviction_gate PR, metrics, tests — due 2026-03-29
- SDK/Docs — resume-dedupe opt-in spec & examples — due 2026-03-27 (owner: SDK team)
- Ravi S — coordinate canary, collect results, publish closure note — due 2026-04-08

Elena T: Synthetic running in dev now. Dev dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/streaming/heartbeat-dev Will promote after stable runs.

Marta G: Starting PR work, will ping with link.

sre-bot: INC-2026-820 updated: Elena T added synthetic metric, Marta G opened PR #4718 (WIP).

Ravi S: Great progress. Drop short status updates here; I'll prepare the closure checklist once canary passes. Closing this thread for now unless blockers appear.

Elena T: Will post staging link once promoted.

Marta G: PR posted and CI green, linking in INC-2026-820.

Ravi S: Thanks — reopening if regressions show up. :thumbsup:
